text.tspan: Using improved water sources: urban vs. rural population 2024
Share of people who use an improved drinking water source, regardless of collection time. An improved drinking
water source is a safely designed drinking water source and includes e.g. piped water, boreholes or tubewells

tspan.tspan: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
